description: This file defines data structures and constants for audit logging in the Mattermost project, including audit record structure, event data, actor info, error info, and utility functions for managing audit records.

classes.name: AuditRecord
classes.description: Represents an audit log entry with fields for event name, status, event data, actor info, meta information, and error details.

classes.name: AuditEventData
classes.description: Contains specific data about the audited event, including parameters, prior and resulting state, and object type.

classes.name: AuditEventActor
classes.description: Holds information about the entity that triggered the audit event, such as user ID, session ID, client, and IP address.

classes.name: EventMeta
classes.description: Stores additional metadata related to the event, like API path and cluster ID.

classes.name: AuditEventError
classes.description: Contains error details if the audit event failed, including description and status code.

classes.name: Auditable
classes.description: Interface for objects that can be audited, requiring an Auditable() method returning a map of their data.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Marks the audit record as successful.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Marks the audit record as failed.

methods.name: AddEventParameterToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds a parameter of various types to the audit record's event data.

methods.name: AddEventParameterAuditableToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds an Auditable object as a parameter to the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventParameterAuditableArrayToAuditRec
methods.description: Adds an array of Auditable objects as parameters to the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventPriorState
methods.description: Sets the prior state of the object in the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventResultState
methods.description: Sets the resulting state of the object in the audit record.

methods.name: AddEventObjectType
methods.description: Specifies the object type involved in the event.

methods.name: AddMeta
methods.description: Adds additional metadata to the audit record.

methods.name: AddErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error code for a failed event.

methods.name: AddErrorDesc
methods.description: Sets the error description for a failed event.

methods.name: AddAppError
methods.description: Adds an AppError object to the audit record, setting error code and description.
